# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:

  version: "0.29.28"
  python_max: "3.14"
  # to be adjusted to match `conda-forge-pinning` per Python EOL
  real_python_min: "3.11"
  # derived
  patch_version: ${{ (version | split('.'))[2] }}
  dagster_version: 1.13.${{ patch_version }}
  dagster: dagster ${{ dagster_version }}.*
  # snowflake
  ## see https://github.com/conda-forge/snowflake-snowpark-python-feedstock/pull/95
  python_snowflake_max: "3.13"
  ## see https://github.com/conda-forge/dagster-libs-feedstock/issues/203
  python_snowflake_pyspark_max: "3.12"
  # utility
  pip_install: |-
    -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation --check-build-dependencies --disable-pip-version-check

recipe:
  name: dagster-libs
  # the epoch is due to a historic issue with `conda-build` outputs
  # https://github.com/conda-forge/dagster-feedstock/issues/301
  version: 1!${{ version }}

build:
  number: 0

      name: dagster-airbyte

      url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/d/dagster-airbyte/dagster_airbyte-${{ version }}.tar.gz
      sha256: a8be5f0043827aecc4a6fdb558f91edba50565ac49b14fef38bd179650e15aaa
    build:
      noarch: python
      skip: python_min != real_python_min
      script: ${{ PYTHON }} ${{ pip_install }}
      python:
        entry_points:
          - dagster-airbyte = dagster_airbyte.cli:main
    requirements:
      host:
        - hatchling >=1.19.0
        - pip
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
      run:
        - ${{ dagster }}
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - python-dateutil
        - requests
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          strict: true
          site_packages:
            - dagster_airbyte/**
            - dagster_airbyte-${{ version }}.dist-info/**
      - python:
          imports:
            - dagster_airbyte
          pip_check: true
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - ${{ python_max }}.*
      - script:
          - dagster-airbyte --help
    about:
